people.name: John Edward Foster
people.bio_note: Founder and Chairman. Born April 2, 1944, on Staten Island, NY. Earned a B.S. in Biology from Wagner College, briefly taught General Science, then joined the U.S. Air Force, earning his pilot wings in February 1968. Served four years as a pilot in Vietnam and various U.S. postings, and was awarded the Distinguished Flying Cross. Later worked as a Marketing Rep for Hallmark Cards, flew for Eastern Airlines, earned a Master's in Accounting and Taxation from Fairleigh Dickinson University during a furlough, and worked at McDonnell Douglas writing crew procedures for the C-17 aircraft before founding the firm in 1991. Confirmed to be Todd Foster's father.
people.bio_source: Firm website (timgt.com/company) for detailed military/career narrative; corroborated by LinkedIn profile ('Principal — Total Investment Management') confirming his role and firm founding history
people.phase4_note: Phase 4 verification (2026-07-03): the Distinguished Flying Cross claim is confirmed verbatim on the firm's own website (timgt.com/company), but no independent military-record source (DFC Society, veteran databases) could be found naming him. Plausible for a Vietnam-era Air Force pilot, but currently single-sourced to the firm. Verdict: PARTIAL.

people.name: Todd Michael Foster
people.bio_note: Chief Executive Officer; confirmed son of founder John E. Foster II. Born and raised in Emerson, NJ. B.S. in Accounting from Rutgers University's Janice H. Levin School of Business. Worked at Ernst & Young LLP in the National 401(k)/Pension Department during and after college, in audit and real estate consulting roles, and obtained his CPA license there, including work on IPOs. Joined Total Investment Management in January 1998, earned the Accredited Investment Fiduciary (AIF) designation in 2009, and sits on the firm's investment committee. Hosts TIMGT's Weekly Market Update video series, presenting market recaps for the firm's airline-industry client base.
people.bio_source: Firm website (timgt.com/company) for career narrative; corroborated by ZoomInfo (Chief Executive Officer at Total Investment Management) and independently-referenced Weekly Market Update video series found in web search

firm_note.text: Founded December 1991 by former military/commercial pilots John E. Foster II and James Hughes (originally HFG Asset Allocation Service), renamed Total Investment Management in 1998. Specializes in financial and retirement planning exclusively for airline industry professionals (pilots, flight attendants). Over 1,000 aviation families served, ~$1.35B AUM. Family-owned: John Foster (Chairman/founder) and his son Todd Foster (CEO) are the principal owners.
firm_note.source: Firm website (timgt.com/company); corroborated by LinkedIn and ZoomInfo listing
